reason: I'll create the breach first so there is a damaged vessel to address.
expectation: The rough edge will cut the skin and a small blood vessel, setting up the bleeding response.

alternatives.reason: The clotting proteins may form part of the response, but I want to establish the injury first.

effect: The cut exposes a bleeding vessel that has already narrowed; I can now address the leak.
reaction: The narrowing is visible, though its purpose is not explained.
reason: I'll bring platelets to the cut to begin limiting the bleeding.
expectation: Platelets will gather at the damaged vessel and help form an initial plug.

alternatives.reason: Clotting factors may also help stop bleeding, but the platelets seem a direct next step at the cut.

effect: The platelets form an initial plug that slows the leak; clotting proteins are the remaining available action.
reaction: The explanation makes the platelets' role clear.
reason: I'll combine the clotting proteins to continue addressing the bleeding; it's the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: The activated factors may convert fibrinogen into fibrin to help reinforce the plug, though the next result is uncertain.

effect: The clotting factors produced fibrin threads, which can now be combined with the platelet plug.
reaction: The mesh makes the intended reinforcement visible, though the conversion is not explained.
reason: I'll add the fibrin threads to the plug; this is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: The threads will reinforce the platelet plug and help stop the bleeding.

effect: The fibrin mesh reinforced the platelet plug and stopped the bleeding, while the skin remained open.
reaction: The distinction between sealing the vessel and closing the skin is useful and clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding fibrin to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: the planned picture and explanation distinguish stopping the vessel leak from healing the skin.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making fibrin threads was comparatively thin: the result shows a mesh but does not explain how activated clotting factors produce it from fibrinogen.

surprise.text: The vessel was already narrowed immediately after the cut, although the result did not explain the narrowing.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the clotting-factor combination leaves its biochemical connection unexplained. The menu also supplied compatibility, so I did not discover that relationship through experimentation.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, mainly to see how the still-open skin is repaired after bleeding stops.
